name: finite_discarded_trace
header:
theorem finite_discarded_trace {E : Type*} {G : Graph Plane E} [G.Finite]
    {drawing : E → ℝ → Plane} (hD : G.IsDrawing drawing)
    (es : Fin 3 → E) (ws : Fin 3 → Plane) (v : Plane)
    (hinc : ∀ i, G.IsLink (es i) v (ws i))
    (hcover : ∀ e ∈ E(G), G.Inc e v → ∃ i, es i = e)
    (f : Fin 3 → ℝ → Plane)
    (hf : ∀ i, ContinuousOn (f i) I ∧ InjOn (f i) I ∧
      f i '' I = Graph.edgeArc drawing (es i) ∧ f i 0 = v ∧ f i 1 = ws i)
    (a : Fin 3 → ℝ) (ha : ∀ i, 0 < a i ∧ a i ≤ 1) :
    ∃ K : Set Plane, IsCompact K ∧ v ∉ K ∧
      Graph.pointSet G drawing = K ∪ ⋃ i, f i '' Icc 0 (a i)

name: actual_binary_trivalent_star

name: short_arm_family_of_isDrawing

theorem short_arm_family_of_isDrawing {E ι : Type*} {G : Graph Plane E}

        f i '' I = Graph.edgeArc drawing (es i) ∧ f i 0 = v ∧ f i 1 = ws i) ∧
      (∀ i j, i ≠ j → ∀ z ∈ (fun t : ℝ => f i (t/2)) '' I,

name: three_frame_of_isDrawing
header:
theorem three_frame_of_isDrawing {E : Type*} {G : Graph Plane E}
    {drawing : E → ℝ → Plane} (hD : G.IsDrawing drawing)
    (es : Fin 3 → E) (ws : Fin 3 → Plane) (v : Plane)
    (hinc : ∀ i, G.IsLink (es i) v (ws i)) (hids : Function.Injective es) :
    ∃ (f : Fin 3 → ℝ → Plane) (H : Plane ≃ₜ Plane) (c s : ℝ) (q : Plane),
      (∀ i, ContinuousOn (f i) I ∧ InjOn (f i) I ∧
        f i '' I = Graph.edgeArc drawing (es i) ∧ f i 0 = v ∧ f i 1 = ws i) ∧
      |c| < 2 ∧ 0 < s ∧ s ≤ 1/2 ∧ 0 < q 1 ∧ H v = 0 ∧
      H '' (f 0 '' Icc 0 (1/6) ∪ f 1 '' Icc 0 (1/6)) = centeredCarrier c ∧
      H '' (f 2 '' Icc 0 s) = segment ℝ (0:Plane) q ∧
      H (f 0 (1/6)) = Plane.mk (2-c) 0 ∧
      H (f 1 (1/6)) = Plane.mk (-2-c) 0 ∧ H (f 2 s) = q

name: actual_three_incident_frame
header:
theorem actual_three_incident_frame {V E : Type*} {G : Nanuq.Source.EdgeGraph V E}
    (D : G1OuterLabelledMultigraphCurves.PlanarCurves G)
    (es : Fin 3 → E) (ws : Fin 3 → V) (v : V)
    (hinc : ∀ i, G.Inc (es i) v (ws i)) (hids : Function.Injective es) :
    ∃ (f : Fin 3 → ℝ → Plane) (H : Plane ≃ₜ Plane) (c s : ℝ) (q : Plane),
      (∀ i, ContinuousOn (f i) I ∧ InjOn (f i) I ∧
        f i '' I = Graph.edgeArc (NanuqFaithfulSupplierDrawing.curve D) (es i) ∧
        f i 0 = NanuqFaithfulSupplierDrawing.vertex D v ∧
        f i 1 = NanuqFaithfulSupplierDrawing.vertex D (ws i)) ∧
      |c| < 2 ∧ 0 < s ∧ s ≤ 1/2 ∧ 0 < q 1 ∧
      H (NanuqFaithfulSupplierDrawing.vertex D v) = 0 ∧
      H '' (f 0 '' Icc 0 (1/6) ∪ f 1 '' Icc 0 (1/6)) = centeredCarrier c ∧
      H '' (f 2 '' Icc 0 s) = segment ℝ (0:Plane) q ∧
      H (f 0 (1/6)) = Plane.mk (2-c) 0 ∧
      H (f 1 (1/6)) = Plane.mk (-2-c) 0 ∧ H (f 2 s) = q

name: square_first_exit
header:
theorem square_first_exit (f : ℝ → Plane) (hf : ContinuousOn f I)
    (hzero : f 0 = 0) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r)
    (hend : r ≤ max |f 1 0| |f 1 1|) :
    ∃ s ∈ I, 0 < s ∧ max |f s 0| |f s 1| = r ∧

name: straighten_upper_first_prefix
header:
theorem straighten_upper_first_prefix (f : ℝ → Plane) (hf : ContinuousOn f I)
    (hi : InjOn f I) (h0 : f 0 = 0) {r s : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r)
    (hs : s ∈ I) (hsp : 0 < s) (he : max |f s 0| |f s 1| = r)
    (hbefore : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 s, t < s → max |f t 0| |f t 1| < r)
    (hy : ∀ t ∈ Ioc 0 s, 0 < f t 1) :
    ∃ H : Plane ≃ₜ Plane, (∀ z : Plane, z 1 = 0 → H z = z) ∧
      H '' (f '' Icc 0 s) = segment ℝ (0:Plane) (f s) ∧ H (f s) = f s

name: line_preserving_third_germ
header:
theorem line_preserving_third_germ (f : ℝ → Plane) (hf : ContinuousOn f I)
    (hi : InjOn f I) (h0 : f 0 = 0) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r)
    (hend : r ≤ max |f 1 0| |f 1 1|)
    (hline : ∀ t ∈ I, 0 < t → max |f t 0| |f t 1| ≤ r → f t 1 ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (s : ℝ) (H : Plane ≃ₜ Plane) (q : Plane),
      s ∈ I ∧ 0 < s ∧ 0 < q 1 ∧
      (∀ z : Plane, z 1 = 0 → H z = z) ∧
      H '' (f '' Icc 0 s) = segment ℝ (0:Plane) q ∧ H (f s) = q

name: three_continued_germ_frame
header:
theorem three_continued_germ_frame (f : Fin 3 → ℝ → Plane)
    (hc : ∀ i, ContinuousOn (f i) I) (hi : ∀ i, InjOn (f i) I)
    (hzero : ∀ i, f i 0 = f 0 0)
    (hmeet : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → ∀ z ∈ f i '' I, z ∈ f j '' I → z = f 0 0) :
    ∃ (H : Plane ≃ₜ Plane) (c s : ℝ) (q : Plane),
      |c| < 2 ∧ s ∈ I ∧ 0 < s ∧ 0 < q 1 ∧ H (f 0 0) = 0 ∧
      H '' (f 0 '' Icc 0 (1/3) ∪ f 1 '' Icc 0 (1/3)) = centeredCarrier c ∧
      H '' (f 2 '' Icc 0 s) = segment ℝ (0:Plane) q ∧
      H (f 0 (1/3)) = Plane.mk (2-c) 0 ∧
      H (f 1 (1/3)) = Plane.mk (-2-c) 0 ∧ H (f 2 s) = q

name: trivalent_local_drawing
header:
theorem trivalent_local_drawing {E : Type*} {G : Graph Plane E} [G.Finite]
    {drawing : E → ℝ → Plane} (hD : G.IsDrawing drawing)
    (es : Fin 3 → E) (ws : Fin 3 → Plane) (v : Plane)
    (hinc : ∀ i, G.IsLink (es i) v (ws i)) (hids : Function.Injective es)
    (hcover : ∀ e ∈ E(G), G.Inc e v → ∃ i, es i = e) :
    ∃ (H : Plane ≃ₜ Plane) (ε : ℝ) (q : Plane),
      0 < ε ∧ ε < ‖q‖ ∧ 0 < q 1 ∧ H v = 0 ∧
      (H '' Graph.pointSet G drawing) ∩ ball 0 ε =
        ({z : Plane | z 1 = 0} ∪ segment ℝ (0:Plane) q) ∩ ball 0 ε

name: straighten_two_continued_germs
header:
theorem straighten_two_continued_germs
    (f g : ℝ → Plane) (hfc : ContinuousOn f I) (hgc : ContinuousOn g I)
    (hfi : InjOn f I) (hgi : InjOn g I) (h0 : f 0 = g 0)
    (hmeet : ∀ z ∈ f '' I, z ∈ g '' I → z = f 0) :
    ∃ H : Plane ≃ₜ Plane,
      H '' (f '' Icc 0 (1/3) ∪ g '' Icc 0 (1/3)) = Nanuq.CornerShear.horizontal ∧
      H (f (1/3)) = Plane.mk 2 0 ∧ H (g (1/3)) = Plane.mk (-2) 0 ∧
      (H (f 0)) 1 = 0 ∧ |(H (f 0)) 0| < 2
